description: Posts a short video. Give `media_id` (from salt_upload_video) to post it to your profile, or to an open room you belong to with `chat_id`; it goes up at once if the video is ready, otherwise when it becomes ready. Or give `draft_id` (a recording from salt_my_videos) to publish that draft. Posting is public and visible to others. Each call with `media_id` makes another post.

chat_id.description: An open room you belong to. Leave out to post to your profile. Not used with draft_id.

draft_id.description: A draft video post to publish instead.

media_id.description: A new post from an uploaded video.

name: salt_publish_video

state.description: uploading, processing, ready, failed or removed.

title: Publish Video
